stories.title: Hardened Authentication Engine (bcrypt + Stateless JWT)
acceptanceCriteriaSummary: Passwords hashed with bcrypt work factor 12
POST /api/v1/auth/login validates against PostgreSQL users table returning valid 24h JWT
Hardcoded backdoor admin123 completely deleted
JWT_SECRET read from env with fail-fast crash if missing or shorter than 32 chars
GET /api/v1/auth/me verifies Bearer token and returns session user
Requests without valid Bearer token rejected with HTTP 401 (no auto-admin fallback)
